description: Qualité de l'air is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. La surveillance de la qualité de l’air dans les gares souterraines d’Ile-de-France est un enjeu fort pour SNCF Gares & Connexions. SNCF Gares & Connexions IDF réalise un suivi permanent de la qualité de l’air dans les enceintes ferroviaires souterraines franciliennes. Coverage: France. The portal files it under Gares. Its keywords are qualité de l'air, gares souterraines. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
